title: 雅思·科研与探索 · 64 句
description: 研究价值、资助、方法证据、伦理、合作、传播、空间探索与科研制度。

items.zh: 基础研究的用途有时无法提前预测。
items.en: The applications of basic research are sometimes unforeseeable.
answers: The applications of basic research are sometimes unforeseeable.

items.zh: 要求立即回报可能排挤长期探索。
items.en: Demands for immediate returns can displace long-term exploration.
answers: Demands for immediate returns can displace long-term exploration.

items.zh: 没有成功的实验也可能排除错误路径。
items.en: Unsuccessful experiments can still eliminate unproductive avenues.
answers: Unsuccessful experiments can still eliminate unproductive avenues.

items.zh: 科学发现通常依赖许多人的积累。
items.en: Scientific discovery often builds on many people's contributions.
answers: Scientific discovery often builds on many people's contributions.

items.zh: 应用价值只是研究价值的一部分。
items.en: Practical utility is only one dimension of research value.
answers: Practical utility is only one dimension of research value.

items.zh: 重复研究有助于判断结果是否稳健。
items.en: Replication helps establish whether findings are robust.
answers: Replication helps establish whether findings are robust.

items.zh: 没有发现预期效果的研究也值得发表，否则读者可能高估成功的频率。
items.en: Studies finding no expected effect also merit publication; otherwise, readers may overestimate how often success occurs.
answers: Studies finding no expected effect also merit publication; otherwise, readers may overestimate how often success occurs.
items.notes: otherwise 引出不发表阴性结果可能造成的偏差。

items.zh: 研究中断可能浪费已经投入的资源。
items.en: Interrupted research can waste resources already committed.
answers: Interrupted research can waste resources already committed.

items.zh: 短期资助周期可能不适合长期观测。
items.en: Short funding cycles may poorly suit long-term observations.
answers: Short funding cycles may poorly suit long-term observations.

items.zh: 评审者需要理解不同学科的产出方式。
items.en: Reviewers need to recognise differences in disciplinary outputs.
answers: Reviewers need to recognise differences in disciplinary outputs.

items.zh: 竞争性资助可能促进质量，也增加申请负担。
items.en: Competitive funding can encourage quality while increasing application burdens.
answers: Competitive funding can encourage quality while increasing application burdens.

items.zh: 小团队提出的新问题可能跨越常见学科分类，因此需要灵活的评审安排。
items.en: A small team's question may cross conventional disciplinary boundaries and therefore require flexible review arrangements.
answers: A small team's question may cross conventional disciplinary boundaries and therefore require flexible review arrangements.
items.notes: cross boundaries：跨越界限；therefore 连接评审需求。

items.zh: 机构声望不能替代对方案本身的评价。
items.en: Institutional prestige cannot substitute for assessment of the proposal.
answers: Institutional prestige cannot substitute for assessment of the proposal.
Institutional prestige can't substitute for assessment of the proposal.

items.zh: 资助者应说明选择项目的标准。
items.en: Funders should explain their selection criteria.
answers: Funders should explain their selection criteria.

items.zh: 设备共享可以降低重复购置成本。
items.en: Shared equipment can reduce duplicated capital costs.
answers: Shared equipment can reduce duplicated capital costs.

items.zh: 科研预算也需要考虑技术支持人员。
items.en: Research budgets must also account for technical support staff.
answers: Research budgets must also account for technical support staff.

items.zh: 测量误差可能改变看似明确的结论。
items.en: Measurement error can alter apparently clear conclusions.
answers: Measurement error can alter apparently clear conclusions.

items.zh: 提出一种合理机制可以帮助解释统计关联，却不能单凭这一点证明因果。
items.en: A plausible mechanism can help explain a statistical association without establishing causation on its own.
answers: A plausible mechanism can help explain a statistical association without establishing causation on its own.
items.notes: without ... on its own 限定机制解释所能支持的结论。

items.zh: 事先公开分析计划，可以减少研究者在看到结果后只挑有利分析来报告的空间。
items.en: Publishing an analysis plan in advance leaves less room to select favourable analyses after seeing the results.
answers: Publishing an analysis plan in advance leaves less room to select favourable analyses after seeing the results.
items.notes: leave less room to：减少余地；对比事先计划与事后选择。

items.zh: 不同方法可能揭示同一问题的不同方面。
items.en: Different methods can reveal different aspects of one question.
answers: Different methods can reveal different aspects of one question.

items.zh: 实验室中的效果未必能在真实环境中重现。
items.en: Laboratory effects may not recur in real-world settings.
answers: Laboratory effects may not recur in real-world settings.

items.zh: 极端条件下的试验不能代表常态。
items.en: Tests under extreme conditions do not represent typical circumstances.
answers: Tests under extreme conditions do not represent typical circumstances.
Tests under extreme conditions don't represent typical circumstances.

items.zh: 样本多样性影响结论的推广范围。
items.en: Sample diversity affects how widely conclusions can be generalised.
answers: Sample diversity affects how widely conclusions can be generalised.

items.zh: 数据透明有助于发现错误，而不是证明不会出错。
items.en: Data transparency helps expose errors rather than guarantee their absence.
answers: Data transparency helps expose errors rather than guarantee their absence.

items.zh: 研究参与者需要理解退出的权利。
items.en: Research participants need to understand their right to withdraw.
answers: Research participants need to understand their right to withdraw.

items.zh: 同意不能建立在误导性承诺之上。
items.en: Consent cannot rest on misleading promises.
answers: Consent cannot rest on misleading promises.
Consent can't rest on misleading promises.

items.zh: 脆弱群体可能需要额外的保护措施。
items.en: Vulnerable participants may require additional safeguards.
answers: Vulnerable participants may require additional safeguards.

items.zh: 潜在社会收益不能自动抹去个人风险。
items.en: Potential social benefits do not automatically cancel individual risks.
answers: Potential social benefits do not automatically cancel individual risks.
Potential social benefits don't automatically cancel individual risks.

items.zh: 动物实验需要审查替代方法是否可行。
items.en: Animal studies require consideration of feasible alternatives.
answers: Animal studies require consideration of feasible alternatives.

items.zh: 隐去姓名并不保证数据无法重新识别。
items.en: Removing names does not guarantee that data cannot be reidentified.
answers: Removing names does not guarantee that data cannot be reidentified.
Removing names doesn't guarantee that data can't be reidentified.
Removing names doesn't guarantee that data cannot be reidentified.
Removing names does not guarantee that data can't be reidentified.

items.zh: 伦理审查应伴随研究过程，而不是只在开始。
items.en: Ethical oversight should continue throughout research, not merely precede it.
answers: Ethical oversight should continue throughout research, not merely precede it.

items.zh: 研究者需要披露可能影响判断的利益关系。
items.en: Researchers should disclose interests that could affect their judgement.
answers: Researchers should disclose interests that could affect their judgement.

items.zh: 跨学科合作需要共同理解术语。
items.en: Interdisciplinary collaboration requires shared understanding of terminology.
answers: Interdisciplinary collaboration requires shared understanding of terminology.

items.zh: 没有说明单位和缺失值含义的开放数据，可能很难被准确复用。
items.en: Open data may be difficult to reuse accurately if units and missing values are left unexplained.
answers: Open data may be difficult to reuse accurately if units and missing values are left unexplained.
items.notes: if 引出数据难以复用的条件；left unexplained：未说明。

items.zh: 跨国合作可能受不同规则影响。
items.en: International collaboration can be complicated by differing regulations.
answers: International collaboration can be complicated by differing regulations.

items.zh: 数据收集者的贡献应获得认可。
items.en: Those collecting data deserve recognition for their contribution.
answers: Those collecting data deserve recognition for their contribution.

items.zh: 大型合作中，署名规则应说明谁能为分析负责，而不只是列出参与者。
items.en: In large collaborations, authorship rules should identify who can answer for the analysis, not merely list participants.
answers: In large collaborations, authorship rules should identify who can answer for the analysis, not merely list participants.
items.notes: answer for：对……负责；区分署名与责任。

items.zh: 共享资源不应忽略维护成本。
items.en: Resource sharing should not overlook maintenance costs.
answers: Resource sharing should not overlook maintenance costs.
Resource sharing shouldn't overlook maintenance costs.

items.zh: 地方知识可以帮助研究者提出更合适的问题。
items.en: Local knowledge can help researchers ask more relevant questions.
answers: Local knowledge can help researchers ask more relevant questions.

items.zh: 合作中的信任需要可靠的沟通支持。
items.en: Trust in collaboration needs dependable communication.
answers: Trust in collaboration needs dependable communication.

items.zh: 科研新闻应说明不确定性，而不仅突出发现。
items.en: Research news should communicate uncertainty alongside discoveries.
answers: Research news should communicate uncertainty alongside discoveries.

items.zh: 尚未评审的结果不应被当成定论。
items.en: Unreviewed findings should not be presented as settled conclusions.
answers: Unreviewed findings should not be presented as settled conclusions.
Unreviewed findings shouldn't be presented as settled conclusions.

items.zh: 专家意见的权重取决于相关专长。
items.en: Expert opinion carries weight when the expertise is relevant.
answers: Expert opinion carries weight when the expertise is relevant.

items.zh: 简化解释不能改变原有结论的边界。
items.en: Simplification must preserve the limits of the original conclusion.
answers: Simplification must preserve the limits of the original conclusion.

items.zh: 公众提问可以暴露沟通中的缺口。
items.en: Public questions can reveal gaps in scientific communication.
answers: Public questions can reveal gaps in scientific communication.

items.zh: 一次发现很少足以解决整个争论。
items.en: One discovery rarely settles an entire debate.
answers: One discovery rarely settles an entire debate.

items.zh: 更正论文说明纠错机制在发挥作用。
items.en: Correcting a paper can show that error-correction mechanisms work.
answers: Correcting a paper can show that error-correction mechanisms work.

items.zh: 科普应区分已知事实与开放问题。
items.en: Science communication should distinguish established facts from open questions.
answers: Science communication should distinguish established facts from open questions.

items.zh: 空间观测能够提供地面难以获得的信息。
items.en: Space observations can supply information unavailable from the ground.
answers: Space observations can supply information unavailable from the ground.

items.zh: 太空项目的收益与成本应使用一致口径。
items.en: Space programmes need consistent accounting of benefits and costs.
answers: Space programmes need consistent accounting of benefits and costs.

items.zh: 卫星数量增加也带来轨道管理问题。
items.en: More satellites also create orbital management challenges.
answers: More satellites also create orbital management challenges.

items.zh: 探索任务可能产生原目标之外的技术用途。
items.en: Exploration missions may generate uses beyond their original purpose.
answers: Exploration missions may generate uses beyond their original purpose.

items.zh: 航天器失效后仍可能影响其他任务。
items.en: Defunct spacecraft can continue affecting other missions.
answers: Defunct spacecraft can continue affecting other missions.

items.zh: 数据长期保存有助于未来重新分析。
items.en: Long-term data preservation enables future reanalysis.
answers: Long-term data preservation enables future reanalysis.

items.zh: 国际规则需要跟上商业活动的发展。
items.en: International rules need to keep pace with commercial activity.
answers: International rules need to keep pace with commercial activity.

items.zh: 探索的象征意义不能替代透明预算。
items.en: Exploration's symbolic value does not replace budget transparency.
answers: Exploration's symbolic value does not replace budget transparency.
Exploration's symbolic value doesn't replace budget transparency.

items.zh: 发表数量不能完整衡量科研贡献。
items.en: Publication counts cannot fully measure scientific contribution.
answers: Publication counts cannot fully measure scientific contribution.
Publication counts can't fully measure scientific contribution.

items.zh: 过度强调新颖性可能削弱验证工作。
items.en: Excessive emphasis on novelty can weaken verification work.
answers: Excessive emphasis on novelty can weaken verification work.

items.zh: 导师应帮助学生判断证据强度。
items.en: Supervisors should help students assess evidence strength.
answers: Supervisors should help students assess evidence strength.

items.zh: 稳定岗位有助于保存专门技能。
items.en: Stable positions help retain specialised skills.
answers: Stable positions help retain specialised skills.

items.zh: 研究诚信也依赖合理的激励制度。
items.en: Research integrity also depends on sensible incentives.
answers: Research integrity also depends on sensible incentives.

items.zh: 允许承认错误可以改善研究文化。
items.en: Allowing mistakes to be acknowledged can improve research culture.
answers: Allowing mistakes to be acknowledged can improve research culture.

items.zh: 研究工具的限制应在报告中写明。
items.en: Reports should state the limitations of research tools.
answers: Reports should state the limitations of research tools.

items.zh: 当年轻研究者有理由质疑资深同事时，科研机构应允许他们在不担心报复的情况下提出异议。
items.en: Institutions should let junior researchers challenge senior colleagues without fear of retaliation when they have grounds to disagree.
answers: Institutions should let junior researchers challenge senior colleagues without fear of retaliation when they have grounds to disagree.
items.notes: have grounds to：有理由；without fear of retaliation：不担心报复。
